candidate_skills.canonical_definition: Rewrite quantities into compatible fractional forms before subtraction by finding a common denominator, creating equivalent fractions, or expressing a whole number with a fractional part such as 0/n.
candidate_skills.alignment_notes: A.S01, B.S01, and C.S01 all describe the same preparatory operation: making quantities compatible for subtraction through common denominators, equivalent fractions, or rewriting whole numbers with fractional parts.

candidate_skills.canonical_definition: Convert a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number with a proper fractional part before subtracting.
candidate_skills.alignment_notes: All three experts use essentially the same name and definition for converting nonstandard mixed numbers like 2 3/2 into standard mixed-number form before subtraction.

candidate_skills.canonical_definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the quantities are in compatible form and no regrouping is required.
candidate_skills.alignment_notes: A.S03, B.S03, and C.S03 all represent the core subtraction step performed after alignment or normalization, excluding preparatory rewriting and excluding borrowing/regrouping.

candidate_skills.canonical_definition: Borrow 1 from the whole part when needed to complete fraction subtraction, then express the result in simplified final form such as lowest terms, an integer, or a mixed number.
candidate_skills.alignment_notes: The three experts all combine borrowing/regrouping with final reduction or simplification into one skill concept; wording differs slightly, but the cognitive operation is the same across A.S04, B.S04, and C.S04.

alignment_summary: The three codebooks are highly consistent and align one-to-one across all four skills. Each expert identifies the same four core concepts: aligning fraction forms, normalizing mixed numbers, subtracting aligned parts, and regrouping/simplifying. No unique 1/3 or partial 2/3 concepts were present, and every skill_id maps cleanly to exactly one shared candidate skill.
